/* Decorative rising bubbles (Banner, CTA) */
.ajx-blg:not(#ajx-n) .ajx-bubbles { position: absolute; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; pointer-events: none; z-index: 0; }
.ajx-blg:not(#ajx-n) .ajx-bubbles i { position: absolute; bottom: -70px; width: var(--s); aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 32% 28%, rgba(255,255,255,.95) 0 7%, rgba(255,255,255,.2) 22%, rgba(255,255,255,.05) 62%); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.4); animation: ajxBlgRise var(--d) linear infinite; animation-delay: var(--dl); }
.ajx-blg:not(#ajx-n) .ajx-bubbles i:nth-child(1) { left: 5%; --s: 30px; --d: 17s; --dl: -3s; }
.ajx-blg:not(#ajx-n) .ajx-bubbles i:nth-child(2) { left: 24%; --s: 46px; --d: 23s; --dl: -14s; }
.ajx-blg:not(#ajx-n) .ajx-bubbles i:nth-child(3) { left: 49%; --s: 60px; --d: 27s; --dl: -18s; }
.ajx-blg:not(#ajx-n) .ajx-bubbles i:nth-child(4) { left: 67%; --s: 34px; --d: 20s; --dl: -11s; }
.ajx-blg:not(#ajx-n) .ajx-bubbles i:nth-child(5) { left: 87%; --s: 50px; --d: 25s; --dl: -9s; }
.ajx-blg:not(#ajx-n) .ajx-bubbles i:nth-child(6) { left: 95%; --s: 14px; --d: 13s; --dl: -5s; }
@keyframes ajxBlgRise { 0% { transform: translate(0,0); opacity: 0; } 10% { opacity: 1; } 100% { transform: translate(24px,-120vh); opacity: .2; } }

/* Second gradient layer under the Banner/CTA native background */
.ajx-blg:not(#ajx-n) .ajx-glow-banner { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 0; pointer-events: none; background: radial-gradient(700px 300px at 85% 0%, rgba(90,160,255,.5), transparent 60%); }
.ajx-blg:not(#ajx-n) .ajx-glow-cta { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 0; pointer-events: none; background: radial-gradient(700px 400px at 100% 0%, rgba(90,160,255,.5), transparent 60%); }

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .ajx-blg:not(#ajx-n) .ajx-bubbles i { animation: none !important; }
}
